review_notes: I read the whole file. All six definitions (IsLocalMinOn, IsLocalMaxOn, IsLocalExtrOn, IsLocalMin, IsLocalMax, IsLocalExtr) are named specialisations of the existing IsMinFilter, IsMaxFilter and IsExtrFilter at the filters 𝓝[s] a and 𝓝 a. The module docstring says this and says the lemmas exist so dot notation returns the expected proposition types. The file connects the On and non-On versions with isLocal*On_univ_iff and with the localize/isLocal* lemmas, so it does not create a competing parallel API. The nonrec lemmas restate Filter.Extr results at specific filters, which is standalone lemma duplication and outside this rubric. The two final lemmas, isLocalMax_of_mono_anti' and isLocalMin_of_anti_mono', are theorems rather than concepts. I found no independent competing definition of the concept, and I did not search for one beyond the file itself and its docstring. I abstain.
